title: Thunder Bluff
body: Thunder Bluff, the capital of the tauren, crowns towering mesas at the northern end of Mulgore. Cairne Bloodhoof raised it as a refuge where tauren of every tribe would be welcome. Great lifts carry travelers up from the grass, and long bridges of wood and rope join the central mesa, with its traders, craftsmen and Cairne's great tent, to three outer rises: Elder Rise, Spirit Rise and Hunter Rise.

parts.body: Of late a goblin zeppelin tower on the edge of Spirit Rise sends airships east across the Barrens to Orgrimmar and back again.

title: Elder Rise
body: Elder Rise, east of the central mesa, is the seat of the elders and druids of Thunder Bluff. Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem keeps his lodge here, and writings beside it set down the oldest legends of the Shu'halo. Between the bridges stands the dwelling of Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone, guarded by braves of her own tribe: Cairne keeps his rival close.

title: Spirit Rise
body: Spirit Rise, northwest of the central mesa, is the heart of shamanic learning in Thunder Bluff, where the Skychaser tribe holds great sway. Below its cap, by a path easy to miss, opens a warren of caves called the Pools of Vision, the Forsaken quarter, where Apothecary Zamah speaks for the Royal Apothecary Society to its tauren allies.

parts.body: Not long ago a great earth elemental was loosed in the pools and drove the Forsaken out, until the gladiators Lo'Gosh and Broll Bearmantle brought the cavern roof down upon it. Some suspected Magatha's hand in its coming.

title: Hunter Rise
body: Hunter Rise, south of the central mesa, is the home of Thunder Bluff's hunters and warriors, where the Thunderhorns teach the bow and the bond between hunter and beast. Melor Stonehoof sends the most promising young hunters after quarry ever farther afield, teaching that the tauren hunt at times for food, at times for honor and at times to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

title: Cairne Bloodhoof
body: Cairne Bloodhoof, high chieftain of the tauren, was already old when the Third War began, chief of the Bloodhoof while the centaur hunted his people. He watched the young Warchief Thrall cut down centaur raiders and pledged the tauren to the Horde, and the orcs helped him win Mulgore in return. He raised Thunder Bluff, drew the scattered tribes together, and stood behind the pact that brought the Forsaken into the Horde.

title: Magatha Grimtotem
body: Magatha Grimtotem, the Elder Crone, is matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe and a powerful shaman. She took the lead of her tribe when her mate died in an unforeseen climbing accident, and she holds that she alone is fit to rule the tauren. She is the Forsaken's warmest friend on the bluff, hoping tauren ways can help them become human again, and Cairne lets her dwell on Elder Rise, keeping his rival close.

title: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
body: Hamuul Runetotem, a childhood friend of Cairne, was moved by the druids who stood at Mount Hyjal and sought out Malfurion Stormrage to learn their ways. He became the first tauren druid in nearly twenty generations and leads the druids of the Cenarion Circle from Elder Rise. He helped persuade Thrall to accept the Forsaken into the Horde, and he has walked the Emerald Dream seeking the taint in the Barrens.

parts.body: A green shard from the Barrens, swirling like smoke, showed him not a dream but a nightmare. Things in the Emerald Dream, he warned, are not as the druids thought.
